meta.name: source-companies
meta.description: Find and import target companies from multiple data sources including Apollo, Clay, Google Maps, HG Insights, Ocean.io, and webhooks. Use when user asks about "find companies", "company list", "data sources", "where to find companies", "import companies", "Google Maps leads", "tech stack targeting", "webhooks", "Triggery". Do NOT use for finding individual contacts (use find-contacts) or ICP definition (use define-icp).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多数据源自动找到目标公司并导入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量获取目标公司信息以用于销售或营销。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically find and import target companies from multiple data sources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch acquire target company information for sales or marketing.

howto.what: 当你需要查找目标公司时，Claude会从Apollo、Clay、Google Maps等多个数据源搜索并导入公司信息。它优先使用ColdIQ服务，若不可用则手动整合多来源数据，输出公司列表、技术栈、员工数等详情。
howto.when: 当你提到“find companies”、“company list”、“data sources”、“import companies”等关键词时触发。不用于查找个人联系人（用find-contacts）或定义理想客户画像（用define-icp）。

say.text: 帮我找使用Salesforce、员工50-500人的SaaS公司。
我在芝加哥卖POS软件，找本地餐厅。
say.note: 使用Google Maps和Apify提取餐厅数据。

say.text: 捕捉我LinkedIn帖子互动过的公司。

howto.what_en: When you need to find target companies, Claude will search and import company information from multiple data sources such as Apollo, Clay, Google Maps, etc. It prioritizes ColdIQ service, otherwise manually integrates multi-source data. Output includes company lists, tech stack, employee count, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "find companies", "company list", "data sources", "import companies". Not for finding individual contacts (use find-contacts) or defining ICP (use define-icp).

say_en.text: Find SaaS companies using Salesforce with 50-500 employees.
say_en.note: Claude queries Sales Navigator and HG Insights.

say_en.text: I sell POS software in Chicago, find local restaurants.
say_en.note: Uses Google Maps and Apify scraper.

say_en.text: Capture companies that engaged with my LinkedIn posts.
say_en.note: Set up Triggery webhook to Clay.
